blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator-judge Raffy Tulfo has called out Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyers for seemingly wanting their witness to be an expert on everything, asking whether he is a “super-witness” and later calling him a “supercomputer” as different topics were brought up during the direct examination. Tulfo raised the point when Duterte’s trial resumed on Thursday. He interrupted defense counsel Mark Vinluan’s questioning of former Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) investigator Reinel dela Fuente, saying that the testimony appeared to be spanning different areas of expertise.
